svg.title: Stonehallow - the ancient places
svg.text: SHEET 5 OF 5 · GAZETTEER OF THE ANCIENT PLACES
Small prehistoric places the medieval city kept: each drawn 200 m square, north up, stones black, earthworks hatched.
A Bronze Age burial mound left in the Grand Market; the city's
assemblies are still held on top.
A 6 m menhir at the crossroads where the North and West roads

A 90 m long barrow kept as a lawn in the palace gardens.

An Iron Age hillfort: three rings of ramparts on the hill; a
A holy spring guarded by an ancient standing stone; pilgrims
A tiny stone ring and a rock carved with cups and rings, on
the windiest cliff in the realm.
